title_en: In the Middle of the Village a Drum Beats
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Белки' rendered as 'perhaps'. The last stanza appears to be the mother speaking, as my reading.

words_to_learn.en: settle down, set up a home

lines.cyr: На сред село, мамо, тапан бие,
lines.lat: Na sred selo, mamo, tapan bie,
lines.en: In the middle of the village, mama, a drum beats,

lines.cyr: тапан бие, мамо, оро се вие.
lines.lat: tapan bie, mamo, oro se vie.
lines.en: a drum beats, mama, a dance winds.
All the girls, mama, lead the dance,
lead the dance, mama, sing songs,

lines.cyr: да се женат, мамо, да се вдомат.
lines.lat: da se ženat, mamo, da se vdomat.
lines.en: that they may marry, mama, that they may settle down.

lines.cyr: Пушти мене, мамо, јас да идам,
lines.lat: Pušti mene, mamo, jas da idam,
lines.en: Let me go, mama, let me go,

lines.cyr: да се фатам, мамо, на орото,
lines.lat: da se fatam, mamo, na oroto,

lines.cyr: белки ќе ме чуе мојто либе.
lines.lat: belki ḱe me čue mojto libe.
lines.en: perhaps my love will hear me.

lines.cyr: Не те пуштам, Анѓе, на орото,
lines.lat: Ne te puštam, Anǵe, na oroto,
lines.en: I will not let you go, Anga, to the dance,
to the dance, Anga, in the village,

lines.cyr: таму ти е, Анѓе, твојто либе,
lines.lat: tamu ti e, Anǵe, tvojto libe,

lines.cyr: ќе те грабне, Анѓе, ќе те земе.
lines.lat: ḱe te grabne, Anǵe, ḱe te zeme.
lines.en: he will snatch you, Anga, he will take you.
